model_annotation: The bar chart displays the negative log probability for various medical specialties, with the data categorized under the label "Mistralv0.2-Base" and "Fine-tuned on:" followed by the specialty names. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, including Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, while the vertical axis shows the negative log probability, ranging from -22 to -27. Each specialty is represented by a group of bars, with each bar corresponding to a different fine-tuning condition, indicated by different colors: light blue for the base model, and various shades of orange and brown for the fine-tuned models. The bars are sorted in descending order of the negative log probability for the base model, with the Cardio specialty having the highest negative log probability and Pediatrics the lowest. The fine-tuned models show varying degrees of improvement, with some specialties showing a significant decrease in negative log probability compared to the base model.
